messages:
sara: quick note — noticed increased p95 on dashboard loads, traced to authz RPCs happening per fanout child. small widgets suffering long tails.

alex: can you paste a trace snippet? is this the per-panel permissions call?

sara: snippet:
[2026-03-08T11:02:12Z] dash=id=foo fanout=10 panel=metrics authz=permissions-svc 320ms
[2026-03-08T11:02:12Z] dash=id=foo fetch panel=metrics 12ms
[2026-03-08T11:02:12Z] dash=id=foo panel=alerts authz=permissions-svc 410ms

ben: confirmed in load test. multiplying authz RTTs by fanout count spikes the tail. two levers: dedupe authz (compute required perms once) or short-lived per-request cache.

maya: dedupe is cleaner but needs query->perm analyzer; cache is faster to ship but must handle invalidation and memory caps.

alex: proposal: request-scoped cache keyed by user-epoch (from auth token). cache lives for request lifetime or short TTL (30s). avoids global invalidation.

jamie: for Dedicated we can consider ACL delta push to edges (opt-in). operationally heavier but removes RTT.

sara: plan: (1) spike request-scoped cache in console-query (alex + ben), config `authz.request_cache_ttl_ms=30000`, telemetry for hits/misses; (2) build simple query->perm analyzer for common panel types (sara + jamie); (3) run focused load test simulating many small panels (ben). target staging canary in 2w.

alex: will open draft PR with feature flag and metrics: `console.query.authz_cache.hits`/`misses`. gate with `feature.authz_request_cache`.

maya: include correctness tests for revokes and token epoch rotation. block rollout if >10% incorrect under harness.

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: staging rolling deploy 2026-03-10T08:00:00Z. CI will run integration suite.

ben: attaching load scenario and test plan to the PR. will also add memory smoke test for per-worker caches.

sara: thanks — reconvene after PR + load results. post benchmarks here. :thumbsup:
